# rss-weekly-digest

Reads the RSS feeds you list, keeps the posts from the last 7 days, and writes a digest with a summary and link for each.

Paste the RSS or Atom feeds of the tech blogs you follow. The QuickAgent reads each one, keeps the posts published in the last 7 days, and gives back one digest: highlights of the week, then every post grouped by blog with its date, a one-or-two-sentence summary and its link. Blogs with no posts this week, and feeds that could not be read, are listed at the end rather than left silent.

Drafted by the Drafter (`agentry draft`). Review the manifest, the instructions and this file before you publish;
this README renders on the QuickAgent's page.
